label: Excluded middle support and local decision alternatives
summary: Read materialized Metaphysics IV.7 and the Ross translation, Heyting Disputation opening exchange, existing EM constructive results, thought-bivalence equivalence, assertion-boundary note, and the four EM-consuming rules in the recorded 39-premise GodExists example. Provisional assessment retains EM as a credible prima facie commitment for exact ontic propositions, distinguishing unknown truth from absence of truth. Constructive irrefutability and no-instance-denial constrain denials but do not prove universal EM or defeat withholding; DNE and thought bivalence remain equivalent commitments, not independent corroboration. Identified narrower decision demands: degree order, existence of higher bearers, maximum/root existence and equality; local decisions are constructive support where supplied, not a finite algorithm for all unbounded quantifiers. Exact helper audit and certification remain necessary before replacing global EM. See docs/notes/priority-independence-logic-support-investigation.md, section 4. No floor, rival endpoint, existing source claim or closure change.
